    Class Emap

    Canvas map engine that owns sources, layers, camera state, controls, and edit history.

    Example

    const map = new Emap({ container: 'map' });
    await map.addSource('example', source);
    map.addLayer({ id: 'points', type: 'circle', source: 'example' });

    constructor

    • new Emap(options: MapOptions): Emap

      Create a map engine in an existing DOM container.

      Parameters

      • options: MapOptions

        Required MapOptions object; must include a valid container id string or HTMLElement. Optional fields may be omitted: interaction defaults to enabled, expression evaluation defaults to 'disabled', worker routing defaults to main-thread execution, and workerThreshold defaults to 50000 vertices.

      Returns Emap

      Example

      const map = new Emap({ container: 'map' });

    features

    features: FeatureAccessor

    Read-side feature accessor — engine.features.get(ref) returns one feature's geometry + frozen properties; iter(sourceId, layerId) walks a layer; count(...) is O(1). Constructed lazily in the Emap constructor so test paths that bypass it via Object.create(Emap.prototype) still see a working accessor once they wire up the host.

    beginTransaction

    • beginTransaction(): Transaction

      Begin an atomic multi-step edit. Every op or edit command pushed during the returned transaction's lifetime is staged; on commit(label) they collapse into a single undo entry, on rollback() every touched source's dataset is restored to its pre-transaction state and the selection is reverted.

      Throws if a transaction is already active — nesting isn't supported.

      Returns Transaction

      Example

      const tx = engine.beginTransaction();
      const r1 = await engine.ops.clipLayer({ source, target, mask });
      if (!r1.ok) { tx.rollback(); return; }
      const r2 = await engine.ops.dissolveLayer({ source, target, field: 'STATE' });
      if (!r2.ok) { tx.rollback(); return; }
      await tx.commit('Process boundaries');

    cancelWorkerJobs

    • cancelWorkerJobs(): void

      Hard-cancel any in-flight worker jobs. Safe to call when no worker pool exists (no-op). The pool stays usable — subsequent dataset-replace ops re-spawn a fresh worker.

      mapshaper isn't interruptible mid-command, so this is the only sound abandonment path: terminate the worker, lose any other queued jobs as collateral, and let the next op start over.

      Returns void

    clearSpatialIndex

    • clearSpatialIndex(sourceId?: string): void

      Drop cached per-layer spatial indexes for one source (or all sources when sourceId is omitted).

      Required after in-place geometry edits (translateSelected, rotateSelected, vertex commands) that mutate arc coordinates without changing shape or arc counts — the cache key wouldn't notice and subsequent queries would return prefilter-stale results.

      Dataset-replace ops (clip / dissolve / etc.) automatically invalidate via shape-count or arc-count change; this method is only needed for in-place edits.

      Parameters

      • OptionalsourceId: string

        sourceId accepts string for clearSpatialIndex. Optional; omit to leave unset. Must be assignable to string.

      Returns void

    deleteSelected

    • deleteSelected(): boolean

      Delete every currently-selected feature in one undoable history step.

      Returns true when at least one feature was deleted, false when the selection was empty (in which case nothing is pushed and no events fire).

      Implementation matches mapshaper's deleteFeature / insertFeature pair: shape + data record are spliced out (and back in on undo). Within each layer, deletes proceed in descending-id order so each delete's index stays valid; a single Ctrl+Z reverses the entire batch.

      The selection is cleared on success — the deleted refs no longer exist.

      Returns boolean

      • Defined in src/map/map.ts:2357

    getScaleMetrics

    • getScaleMetrics(
          options?: GetScaleMetricsOptions,
      ): Promise<ScaleViewMetrics | null>

      Measure ground scale for the current view.

      Converts the center-row pixel step through the CRS ellipsoid geodesic inverse, returning meters-per-pixel and the nominal 1:N denominator at the requested DPI. The Web Mercator zoom level is attached only when the map CRS is Web Mercator. Resolves null for unsupported or non-Earth CRSs, empty views, or when the view changed while the measurement was in flight.

      Parameters

      • options: GetScaleMetricsOptions = {}

        options accepts GetScaleMetricsOptions for getScaleMetrics. Defaults to {} when omitted or undefined. Must be assignable to GetScaleMetricsOptions.

    loadSnapshot

    • loadSnapshot(
          input: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> | Blob,
          opts?: LoadSnapshotOptions,
      ): Promise<string[]>

      Restore one or more topology sources from a .msx snapshot via mapshaper's session unpack pipeline. Returns the list of registered source IDs in registration order.

      ID resolution priority (per restored dataset, in order):

      1. opts.idPrefix + ID from snapshot's emap.sources[i].id (if metadata present)
      2. opts.idPrefix + opts.defaultIds[i] (if supplied)
      3. opts.idPrefix + snapshot-<i> fallback

      On ID collision: replace: true (default) removes the existing source first; replace: false rejects without registering anything.

      Edit history and selection are cleared because feature IDs in the replayed history would point to features that no longer exist after dataset replacement. Same semantics as the dataset-replace family (clip, dissolve, mosaic, ...).

      Parameters

      • input: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike> | Blob

        input accepts ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | Blob for loadSnapshot. Required; omission is not allowed. Must be assignable to ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array | Blob.

      • opts: LoadSnapshotOptions = {}

        opts accepts LoadSnapshotOptions for loadSnapshot. Defaults to {} when omitted or undefined. Must be assignable to LoadSnapshotOptions.

      Returns Promise<string[]>

    • prebuildSpatialIndex(sourceId?: string): void

      Eagerly build the per-layer Flatbush spatial index for one source (or every registered source when sourceId is omitted). Useful for paying the build cost in idle time before the user's first hit-test.

    pushCommand

    • pushCommand(cmd: EditCommand): void

      Push an executed EditCommand onto the undo stack.

      Per the memento pattern, the caller is expected to have already performed the work; the command captures what changed so the operation can be reversed on undo. pushCommand does NOT call cmd.do(). It clears any pending redo entries and fires historychange.

    remove

    • remove(): void

      Tear the map down: cancel pending renders, detach every data listener we attached to sources, release each registered control, kill the worker pool, and unmount the canvas. Idempotent — calling it twice is safe.

      After remove() the instance must not be reused. Public methods that touch DOM / timers are left in place for now (they will fail naturally when the underlying resources are gone), but internal host member is guarded so post-teardown event firings don't queue another frame.

      Returns void
